questions.question: A girl goes from A to B with speed 60 km/hr and return from B to A with speed 30 km/hr. If whole journey takes 5 hours, then what is the distance between A and B?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When a person travels a certain distance at speed S₁ and returns at speed S₂ taking total time T, the distance is given by:

Distance = [ (S₁ × S₂) ÷ (S₁ + S₂) ] × Total Time

Distance = [ (60 × 30) ÷ (60 + 30) ] × 5

Distance = [ 1800 ÷ 90 ] × 5 = 20 × 5 = 100 km

**∴ The correct answer is 100 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed from A to B (S₁) = 60 km/hr

Speed from B to A (S₂) = 30 km/hr

Total time taken (T) = 5 hours

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db13c818c5460bd7700857e1bfe0a86e1e29c2019966f1744c3f965a2e2612bd.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculations:**

Let the total distance between A and B be D km.

⇒ Time taken to travel from A to B = D ÷ 60 hours

⇒ Time taken to return from B to A = D ÷ 30 hours

The total time for the whole journey is given as 5 hours.

⇒ (D ÷ 60) + (D ÷ 30) = 5

⇒ (D + 2D) ÷ 60 = 5

⇒ 3D ÷ 60 = 5

⇒ D ÷ 20 = 5

⇒ D = 20 × 5

⇒ D = 100 km

**∴ The correct answer is 100 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed (Equal Distances)

When an object covers two equal distances at speeds S₁ and S₂, the average speed for the entire journey is calculated as (2 × S₁ × S₂) ÷ (S₁ + S₂).

Average Speed (Equal Time Intervals)

When an object travels at speed S₁ for a certain time and at speed S₂ for an equal amount of time, the average speed is simply the arithmetic mean: (S₁ + S₂) ÷ 2.

Relative Speed

If two bodies are moving in the same direction, their relative speed is the difference of their individual speeds (S₁ − S₂). If they are moving in opposite directions, it is the sum of their speeds (S₁ + S₂).

questions.question: Density of population, is expressed as ___________ .

• It is **not an appropriate measure **of population density as it combines two different types of populations and does not provide an **accurate representation of human population density.**

• It is** elected by the people** of the state and has the power to make **laws, approve the state budget, and scrutinize **the work of the government.
 
 
 
• **Lok Sabha **is the **lower house** of the **parliament **of India.
 
 
• It is **elected by the people of India** and has the power to make **laws, approve the national budget, and hold** the government accountable.
 
 
 
• **Rajya Sabha** is the **upper house** of the parliament of India.
 
 
• It is **not directly elected by the people** but is composed of members who are **elected by the state legislatures.**
 
• Its role is to represent the **interests of the states **and act as a check on the **power of the Lok Sabha.**
